[[File:Undead mage.gif|160px|thumb|left|An undead troll being summoned by an undead mage.]]
The '''Undead troll''' is an [[undead]] version of a troll. Being undead, they are vulnerable to the effects of a [[Salve amulet]]. They can be also killed for a [[troll]] [[slayer|slayer assignment]]. They can be found in [[Lucien's outpost]] and are mixed with [[Elite Black Knight]]s, who are aggressive unless the player is wearing [[Dagon'hai robes]] or [[Elite black armour]]. To access Lucien's outpost, you need to have at least made some progress in the [[While Guthix Sleeps]] [[quest]]. The undead trolls wielding [[pickaxes|pickaxe]]s are never aggressive, while the unarmed trolls are aggressive in the same fashion as the [[Elite Black Knight]]s.

It is time consuming to get to Lucien's outpost, so few players go there to kill them. Some players on [[Trolls (Slayer assignment)|slayer assignments for 'trolls']] sometimes, for a change of pace, attack these trolls rather than [[mountain troll]]s, but [[ice troll]]s are as good for drops and easier to reach and slay.

Undead trolls count as trolls for slayer assignments.

==Locations==
The undead trolls live in [[Lucien's outpost]]. To access this camp, players need to go to [[Surok Magis|Surok's]] room at the end of the [[Black Knights' Catacombs]], beneath the [[Black Knights' Fortress]]. They then need to activate the [[strange teleorb]] while having in inventory a [[death rune]] and a [[law rune]], which are consumed.

==Trivia==
* Undead trolls were referred to long before being added to the game. They were first mentioned in [[Nestor Peregrine]]'s [[Explorer's notes]] found within [[Keldagrim Library]].
* Instead of respawning, they are summoned by the [[undead mage]]s.
* They drop regular bones unlike most trolls, which drop [[big bones]].
* Its examine text is a combination of the cliche of zombies eating brains, and how trolls are named after the first thing they (attempt to) eat.
* They were the first trolls to use updated graphics. Other trolls were not updated until March [[2011]].
